text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару and I are on our way
back to
the academy after a day out,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gasp! Graaahhh!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I've r-really done it now! I stepped
through the
school gate with my right
foot!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: You know the old adage, right? "When ye entereth a main gate, ye must steppeth leftly. Ye who dareth to breaketh said rule..." Gulp...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
...Shalt reject the companion with whom
ye
walked through!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
D-does that mean that you and I are
going to
have a falling-out?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I can't let that happen, ever! There's
only one
thing to do!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And my fortune-telling shall tell us what
that is!
Hoppity-rak! Roll on, my little
fortune-telling
pencil, roll on!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
She takes a pencil out of her pocket and
hastily
rolls it on the ground...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Apparently, a liquid will
solve our
worries!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Liquid... Liquid... Oh! Juice is a liquid!
Wait right
here, I'll go buy some!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
She disappears for a moment and comes
back
with a bottle of my favorite juice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The color of the label happens to be
today's
lucky color. Plus, it's the one you
always get!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
That's only because you're always going
out of
your way to help me! Knowing
what you like is the
least I can do!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how affable was your reaction just
now!
We've definitely avoided any
potential discord!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Now, let me buy you one!

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how affable was your reaction just
now!
We've definitely avoided any
potential discord!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Now, let me buy you one!

text_block_list.text:
Huhwha?! There's no need to flatter me
that
much!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you know what I think? We've
definitely
strengthened our friendship!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
We have the fortune-telling pencil to
thank for
that! Praise be to the pencil!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat? You're going to buy me a
drink too?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I was just trying to prevent the
impending discord
between us!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: But if you insist... Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
La-di-da! ♪ What a stroke of luck! All
thanks to
my pencil's divine guidance!
Now, what should I
choose?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
After that, Матиканэфукукитару and I
frequent the
vending machine on our
breaks more often.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару must have liked the

compliment. Afterwards, she makes a
habit of
bringing me drinks every once in
a while.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
